shared_elements: standing human figure with legs apart
justification: Both surfaces include an upright human figure shown frontally with legs apart, but A is a highly schematic stick-like body with a concentric-ring head and long horizontal lines crossing the field, while B shows relief figures standing in a niche within a larger rock face with no comparable geometric motifs. The concentric circle head and linear framing of A have no counterpart in B, and the modes of depiction (linear schematic sign vs. modelled relief figures in an architectural setting) are wholly different.
